children: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited (“Butterfield”) (
| BSX: NTB.BH) today announced the pricing of a registered offering of $600 million aggregate principal amount of Butterfield’s 8.363% Fixed to Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036.

Butterfield intends to use the net proceeds from this offering to finance a portion of the cash consideration and related fees and expenses for its proposed acquisition of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce’s approximately 91.7% interest in CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited and for general corporate purposes.
The offering is expected to close on or about November 25, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

Barclays Capital Inc. and BofA Securities, Inc. are acting as the joint book-running managers. CIBC World Markets Corp., Keefe, Bruyette & Woods, Inc., Piper Sandler & Co., Raymond James & Associates, Inc. and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC are acting as co-managers.

The offering is being made pursuant to a shelf registration statement on Form F-3, including a base prospectus, that was filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) on February 26, 2024 and automatically became effective upon filing. A preliminary prospectus supplement and accompanying prospectus relating to the offering have been filed with the SEC, and a final prospectus supplement and accompanying prospectus relating to the offering will be filed with the SEC, and all of which will be available for free on the SEC’s website located at www.sec.gov. Butterfield is a full-service bank and wealth manager headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. Our principal banking operations are located in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey and Jersey, providing deposit, cash management and lending solutions for individual, business and institutional clients. We provide a full range of wealth management services, comprising trust, private banking, asset management and custody, in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands and Guernsey, trust services in The Bahamas, Singapore and Switzerland, and residential property lending in the UK. Butterfield is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: NTB) and the Bermuda Stock Exchange (symbol: NTB.BH). Further details are available at www.butterfieldgroup.com.
